name: OSS Apparel
old_description: At OSS Apparel, we believe every customer is unique and are committed to providing personalized service that meets your specific needs. Our skilled team will work closely with you to understand your requirements and preferences and tailor our services accordingly. From product selection to design and printing, we strive to deliver a customized experience that exceeds your expectations.
about:
OSS Apparel operates from an 8,500-square-foot facility in East Providence, Rhode Island. The company was founded in 2015 by Mike Almeida, who began with a single heat press in a basement as a side hustle driven by a passion for entrepreneurship and hands-on creativity. Over the past decade, the business has grown into a full-service custom apparel shop rooted in Almeida’s blue-collar work ethic and local ties.

The shop provides screen printing, embroidery, direct-to-film (DTF) transfers, sublimation, banner production, promotional products, graphic design, and brand guide development. Production runs out of the East Providence facility, which added new equipment and a quality-assurance process during a recent re-grand opening. The team handles jobs ranging from one-off custom pieces to larger runs for schools, businesses, and organizations across the region.

Customers include schools, youth sports leagues, regional nonprofits, small businesses launching clothing lines, and corporate clients needing branded uniforms or event gear. OSS Apparel emphasizes word-of-mouth referrals and community partnerships, such as supporting local youth programs and collaborating with nonprofits to strengthen branding through apparel.

The company’s name stands for “Outstanding. Strategic. Service.”—a framework that guides its approach to personalized service, competitive pricing, a 100% satisfaction guarantee, and included graphic design support. Almeida started the venture to build something from the ground up, and the business now positions itself as a reliable print partner that prioritizes fast turnarounds and dependable quality.
built_on: Personalized service tailored to each customer’s needs
Competitive pricing without compromising quality
100% satisfaction guarantee on all work
In-house graphic design support included
Fast turnarounds and dependable quality

name: Oakwell Inc.
old_description: Oakwell is a stocking distributor and custom manufacturer of switchgear, including indoor and outdoor LV/MV distribution and generator switchgear. Equipment meets military specifications and features automatic controls for generator paralleling, load shedding, soft loading/unloading and PLC integration.
about:
Oakwell Inc. was founded in 1987 and is based in Rosenberg, Texas. The company operates as both a stocking distributor and a custom manufacturer of switchgear, providing indoor and outdoor low- and medium-voltage distribution switchgear as well as generator switchgear.

As a custom manufacturer, Oakwell designs and builds switchgear to specific project requirements. Its equipment is designed to meet military specifications and features automatic controls for generator paralleling, load shedding, soft loading and unloading, and PLC integration. In addition to switchgear, the company supplies electrical controls. The facility employs between 10 and 49 people.

The company serves customers in the oil and gas, utilities, and military sectors. Its switchgear and control systems are used in power distribution and generation applications across these industries.

Oakwell differentiates itself by combining a stocked inventory with custom engineering capabilities, delivering switchgear that meets military standards and includes integrated control functions such as generator paralleling and load shedding.

old_description: As more and more people go solar, it pays to have a solar company that understands the products it sells. From local incentives to the difference between the various inverter types, we pride ourselves with knowing the details and getting you the system that matches your needs. Our staff is led by NABCEP certified installers to ensure the highest level of expertise during the installation of your solar system. NABCEP is the premiere certifying body for the solar industry. about:
Ocotillo Solar Electric was founded in 2016 in Albuquerque, New Mexico, by Dominic Westeen. The company began as a locally owned and operated residential solar installer with a focus on bringing high-quality, low-cost solar installations and exemplary customer service to homeowners in the Albuquerque metro area and surrounding communities.

The firm specializes in residential solar photovoltaic design, installation, and maintenance, along with off-grid and battery backup system design and installation. It also provides service and repair work for existing PV systems, roof replacement removal and re-installation of solar arrays, third-party design consultation, and EV charger installation. Since 2016 the team has completed hundreds of home installations across New Mexico, and its collective experience exceeds 1,000 systems.

Ocotillo serves residential homeowners in Albuquerque, Rio Rancho, Corrales, Bernalillo, Placitas, Los Lunas, Belen, Tijeras, Cedar Crest, Sandia Park, and the East Mountains. Customers typically seek grid-tied solar arrays, battery storage for backup power, or EV charging infrastructure, and the company manages permitting, utility interconnection, and incentive paperwork on their behalf.

The company emphasizes its local presence, NABCEP-certified leadership, and a community giving program that has donated over $15,000 to nonprofits since 2017. It partners with distributors to supply modules, inverters, batteries, and EV chargers with warranties, aiming to match quality with low-cost installation.

name: Olympia Sheet Metal Inc
old_description: Since 1990, Olympia Sheet Metal, Inc. has maintained the highest level of service, integrity, reliability and quality. Our innovative, quality products and exceptional customer service have allowed us to become the leader in custom sheet metal fabrication in Olympia and Western Washington.
about:
Olympia Sheet Metal, Inc. was founded in April 1990 in Tumwater, Washington, by Hans Rebitzer, a 25-year veteran of the sheet metal trade. The company began as a five-person shop and grew to a 30-person operation within four years. It remains family-owned and is led by Helga Rebitzer as president.

The firm operates as a full-service sheet metal contractor and HVAC contractor. Its fabrication shop produces custom architectural sheet metal — including roof flashings, kitchen hoods, wall panels, and custom ductwork — in stainless steel, brass, bronze, aluminum, and steel. It also designs, installs, and services commercial and industrial HVAC systems, offering preventive maintenance, retro‑commissioning, boiler and chiller service, and 24/7 emergency repair. The workforce consists of union craftsmen from Sheet Metal Workers Local 66, many with ten to twenty years of tenure.

Customers span healthcare (hospitals, laboratories), commercial real estate (office buildings, banks, restaurants, hotels, shopping centers), industrial manufacturing, government agencies, municipalities, schools, universities, and religious institutions across Pierce, Thurston, Lewis, and Mason counties. Projects range from simple repairs to multi‑million‑dollar fast‑track installations.

The company emphasizes craftsmanship, safety, and duct‑cleanliness standards for healthcare and food‑service environments. Its differentiators include a family‑owned culture, union‑trained staff, OSHA 30/10 safety programs, and quality‑control procedures that prevent mold and airborne contaminants in ductwork.

name: Omega Circuits & Engineering
old_description: Established in 1980, Omega Circuits & Engineering has been a leading manufacturer of rigid printed circuit boards. Specializing in thermal management, Omega offers deliverable solutions to your PCB design to lower thermal coefficients by offering metal based PCBs and heavy copper tracing.   Working side by side with visionary engineers Omega is dedicated to making your design manufacturable and cost competitive.
about:
Omega Circuits & Engineering was founded in 1980 in New Brunswick, New Jersey, as a privately owned manufacturer of high‑technology printed circuit boards. The company grew from modest beginnings to its current 18,000‑square‑foot custom industrial space on two acres, serving a customer base of more than 200 companies that includes military outfits and leaders in electronics and communications.

The shop fabricates rigid PCBs ranging from standard single‑ and double‑sided boards to complex multilayers up to 18 layers, HDI with blind and buried vias, aluminum‑based boards for thermal management, and heavy‑copper designs up to 9 oz. It also provides turnkey assembly — surface‑mount, through‑hole, wire‑harness, box‑build and functional testing — with prototype runs completed in as little as 48 hours. In‑house capabilities extend to copper chem‑mill services, aluminum milling and anodizing, and micro‑section analysis to IPC or military standards.

Omega’s customers operate in high‑frequency/RF microwave, defense, communications and medical industries. The company emphasizes working side‑by‑side with engineers to make designs manufacturable and cost‑competitive, often taking on jobs that other facilities decline.

Differentiators cited by the company include free micro‑section verification on heavy‑copper jobs up to 6 oz, free inventory warehousing for production orders, just‑in‑time consignment programs, and a quality system built on UL approval, ISO 9002 registration and adherence to IPC Class III and MIL‑55110 specifications.

old_description: At OnBoard Circuits our focus is quality, and that extends beyond your PCBs. We promise you top-notch customer service, communication, product management, and value. about:
OnBoard Circuits was founded in 2001 in Scottsdale, Arizona. The company is women- and minority-owned. Founder Jay established the business as a printed circuit board supplier, and the firm has operated from its Scottsdale facility for over two decades.

The shop provides PCB fabrication and assembly services, covering quick-turn prototypes through full-scale production runs. It manages both domestic and offshore manufacturing relationships, and maintains an on-site warehouse to ship repeat orders without quick-turn surcharges. The team supports customers from design and layout through final manufacturing, and offers free tooling on prototype orders.

Customers span military and aerospace programs, home-appliance manufacturers, and university research projects. Long-term clients include companies that have purchased tens of thousands of boards over a decade or more, such as Circle Prime, and the firm also handles one-off repair jobs for legacy electronics.

OnBoard Circuits says its differentiation rests on 25-plus years of industry experience, a network of domestic and offshore partners, on-site warehousing for next-day repeat fulfillment, and a customer-service model that promises 24-hour quote responses, same-day or next-day pricing, and weekend availability. The ownership structure is cited as a deliberate choice to foster a diverse workplace culture.

name: Onofrio's Ultimate Foods LLC
old_description: Based in New Haven, CT, Onofrio’s Ultimate Foods has a long history as a leader in the preparation and distribution of fine food products. But our history goes much deeper than that. A family-run business since 2004, Onofrio’s Ultimate Foods prides itself on the extensive food service expertise of partners Richard Onofrio, Vincent Onofrio, and Edward Onofrio, who have carried on the legacy of the Onofrio family quality and service that began at their family’s grocery store back in 1923.
about:
Onofrio's Ultimate Foods operates from a facility on Wheeler Street in New Haven, Connecticut. The company was established in 2004 as a family-owned venture by partners Richard Onofrio, Vincent Onofrio, and Edward Onofrio, who carried forward a food-service legacy that began at the family's grocery store in 1923.

The business functions as a contract packer and co-manufacturer, offering private-label food packing, co-packing, food bottling, sauce and marinade bottling, and full-scale food manufacturing. Its plant houses kettles ranging from 50 to 1,000 gallons, automated filler funnels, capping and labeling systems, heat shrink-wrap sealing, laser imprinting for expiration dates and lot codes, a LOCK multi-metal detection system, and large-capacity washing and sterilization equipment. Production runs start at a minimum of 100 cases, with packaging options including glass bottles (8–128 oz), hot-fill plastic bottles (8–128 oz), and sealed pouches (8–128 oz). A production manager and an R&D specialist, each with over 25 years of experience, oversee quality assurance and product development.

Clients range from startup entrepreneurs to established corporate and institutional brands, including nationally recognized names that remain confidential. The company serves the food-service, specialty-food, organic, and natural-products sectors, providing certified packing for Kosher, gluten-free, non-GMO, and organic specifications.

Onofrio's differentiates itself by not marketing any products under its own label, so client formulations receive undivided attention. The family-owned structure is cited as a guarantee of consistent quality and discretion, and the firm emphasizes end-to-end guidance from recipe development through distribution.

name: Opus Woodworking
old_description: We take pride in our meticulous attention to detail, using only the finest materials and techniques to ensure every piece is crafted to perfection. From concept to completion, we work closely with you to create meaningful, lasting additions to your home or business.
about:
Opus Woodworking was established in 2008 in Columbus, Ohio, as a design-driven atelier focused on fine woodworking. The company operates as a custom woodworking business crafting artisanal, handcrafted wood products for residential and commercial spaces.

The shop produces bespoke furniture, architectural wood installations, custom cabinetry, and shelving systems including floating shelves, full-wall storage, partitions, and feature walls. Pieces are handcrafted from premium hardwoods using time-honored joinery techniques and precise construction methods. The workshop also fabricates mantels, stair railings, built-in bookshelves, and fireplace surrounds.

Opus serves discerning homeowners, architects, interior designers, and builders across residential and commercial projects. Clients have included homeowners such as Sarah Karakaian and Terri Dalenta, as well as design firms like Wannemacher Interiors and JWAA Interiors, who commission mantels, built-in bookshelves, and historically appropriate interior finishes.

The company states it differentiates itself through an uncompromising commitment to mastery over mass production, emphasizing authenticity, craftsmanship, and legacy. Its declared principles include not rushing projects, not compromising materials, and not overlooking details, with a collaborative process from consultation through installation.

old_description: (OMPP) started in 2011 with a few good product ideas and a lot of know how. In just a few years OMPP has added more products and new equipment and in 2013 established a products line called HITCH-GEAR. This has allowed us to expand into Custom Injection Molding. OMPP is a quality first, efficient, low cost shop with flexibility to meet the demand in any market. Our extensive knowledge and innovation can tackle any molding issue.
about:
Oregon Made Plastic Products, Inc. (OMPP) was founded in 2011 in Canby, Oregon, by a team with a few product ideas and deep molding know‑how. The company launched its own HITCH‑GEAR product line in 2013, which funded an expansion into custom injection molding services.

Today OMPP operates seven injection molding machines ranging from 25 to 90 tons (with experience up to 150 tons), specializing in small‑part and short‑run production. The shop offers in‑house pad printing, sonic welding, tooling, prototyping, CNC milling, and full mold design and sourcing. It works with both local and offshore mold makers and automation partners to handle projects from concept through production.

The company serves aerospace, automotive, medical, industrial, and electrical sectors. Its customers include manufacturers seeking alternatives to long overseas lead times, entrepreneurs needing a domestic molder, and other molders looking for overflow or specialty capacity.

OMPP emphasizes a quality‑first, low‑cost approach with flexibility to meet varied demand. Sustainability is a stated priority: the firm designs its own products to incorporate regrinds and reprocessed materials, and its tree logo reflects a commitment to reducing plastic waste. When a job falls outside its capabilities, OMPP refers customers to other molders in the region.
